name: Snap CourtYard
description: Snap two footprint courtyards corner-to-corner or edge-to-edge.
description_full: PCB editor action plugin. Select exactly two footprints, then pick a snap mode: Corner-to-Corner (choose a corner on the anchor and a corner on the moving footprint; both meet) or Edge-to-Edge (choose an edge on each; the moving footprint slides along the perpendicular axis until edges touch, parallel-axis position is preserved). Optional dx/dy offset in millimetres. Corners and edges come from the merged F.CrtYd + B.CrtYd courtyard bounding box; falls back to the footprint bounding box when no courtyard is defined. Rotation preserved; only translation applied.
